matches.quote: Fig. 4c shows the ππ intra-band channel dominating −Im χ⁰ from ~0.5 to 1.5 eV... show the Fig. 4c decomposition at several q with the orbital weighting of Eq. 32 applied
the TB bands (Fig. S3) deviate visibly from DFT along A–L–H and for one σ band near Γ–A close to E_F; comment on the effect on the Lindhard function
take spectra with σ incident polarization at the same q, which under Eq. 32 change the p_x/p_y weights at fixed q and so separate matrix-element effects from dispersion
The authors should show an incident-energy RIXS map across the pre-edge at fixed geometry (one or two q values) to demonstrate a constant energy loss and resonance behaviour
It is also unclear whether the Lindhard and RPA calculations (Figs. 3d, 3e, 4) used the actual (q_∥, q_⊥) of each spectrum or only q_∥ along Γ–M with q_⊥ = 0
The BSE spectrum in Fig. 2b also has almost no weight between ~0.6 and 2.5 eV, where the experiment shows a large tail... compare full lineshapes at each (q_∥, q_⊥)
The novelty claims are overstated... particle–hole continua have been compared with Lindhard-type calculations in RIXS and momentum-resolved EELS of metallic oxides and other systems
The sum-rule argument (Eq. 1) applies only at small q below the plasmon cutoff and shows that the continuum carries small, not zero, weight... so the statement... should be softened.
show data that separate momentum from geometry, for example... the Γ–K data mentioned in SI Sec. A but never shown (... Γ–M versus Γ–K is a useful check).

notes: C7 asks about the ~1 eV branch in Fig. 3d (whether it is pi-pi intraband and suppressed by polarization); P2 and P10 discuss the same 0.5-1.5 eV pi-pi intraband feature in chi^0 via Fig. 4b/4c and how the polarization weighting of Eq. 32 shifts weight away from it, so C7 is marked partly. C5 asks for complementary XAS data supporting the polarization suppression towards M; P17 and P18 ask for polarization- and angle-resolved RIXS controls to test the same geometry/polarization effect, so C5 is marked partly. C10 asks to qualify the claim that EELS/IXS cannot see the continuum for low-density/semimetals; P14 and P7 ask to soften and qualify the same claim with respect to the plasmon cutoff and multiband screening, so C10 is marked partly.
